source.observedIdentity: Brown-haired mustached adult man with blue-gray sleeves and brown leather apron/vest. Screen-left round gray metal shield, screen-right wooden spear with gray leaf-shaped tip; patched trousers.

independentVisualAudit.appearance: Adult light-tan man with short tousled brown hair, thick dark eyebrows, worried brown eyes and drooping brown moustache. No helmet or beard.
independentVisualAudit.costume: Blue-gray rolled-sleeve collared shirt, pale cuffs, brown leather apron/vest with strap fittings and split bottom, brown belt with rectangular brass buckle, belt pouch, short blue-gray trousers patched tan at screen-left knee and gray-beige at screen-right knee, brown boots.
independentVisualAudit.props: Round plain gray metal shield with raised rim, boss and rivets carried by screen-left arm; long wooden spear with gray leaf-shaped spearhead carried in screen-right hand.
independentVisualAudit.anatomy: Exactly two arms and hands. Screen-right hand grips spear; screen-left hand occluded behind shield with forearm entering grip region.
independentVisualAudit.symbolPolicy: No emblems, text, heraldry or invented marks. Rivets, metal fittings and cloth patches are functional details.
